name: Pekahiah
bio: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, reigned over Israel in Samaria for two years, doing evil in the LORD's eyes like Jeroboam before him. Pekah son of Remaliah, one of his own captains, conspired against him and struck him down in the royal palace at Samaria, along with Argob and Arieh and fifty Gileadite men, killing him and taking the throne (2 Kings 15:23-26).
